test_cases.title: Visitor sees the four student services on the home page
test_cases.purpose: Checks that the portal's front page offers every service, so students can find what they need.
test_cases.priority_reason: A missing tile would send students to the office instead of the portal.
test_cases.business_impact: More walk-in queries for the exam section.
test_cases.expected_result: The page shows 'Academic documents', 'Grievance Redressal', 'Track application' and 'Verify certificate'.
acceptance_criteria: All four service names are shown

test_cases.title: Visitor sees the correct International Courier fee
test_cases.purpose: Checks the published delivery fee matches the approved fee matrix.
test_cases.priority_reason: A wrong published fee misleads every overseas applicant.
test_cases.business_impact: Revenue loss of ₹250 per overseas order and complaints.
test_cases.expected_result: The fee schedule shows 'International Courier' with '₹2,500.00'.

test_cases.title: Visitor cannot get a One-Time Password (OTP) with a wrong date of birth
test_cases.purpose: Checks the sign-in confirms the student's identity before sending a One-Time Password (OTP).
test_cases.priority_reason: Anyone knowing a University Seat Number (USN) could open another student's account.
test_cases.business_impact: Data leak and fraudulent document requests.
preconditions: Student 1KV21CS001 exists with date of birth 2003-04-12
steps: Enter '1999-01-01' in the Date of birth field
Enter '9845012345' in the Mobile number field
test_cases.expected_result: The error 'The details you entered do not match our records.' is shown.
acceptance_criteria: No One-Time Password (OTP) page is opened

test_cases.title: Visitor sees an error for an 11-character University Seat Number (USN)
test_cases.purpose: Checks the University Seat Number (USN) format rule of exactly 10 characters.
test_cases.priority_reason: Wrong identifiers could reach the wrong student record.
test_cases.business_impact: Wrong records fetched; data quality issues.
steps: Enter '2003-04-12' in the Date of birth field
Enter '9845012345' in the Mobile number field
test_cases.expected_result: The error 'Invalid USN format' is shown.

test_cases.title: Student cannot request more than 10 copies
test_cases.purpose: Checks the copy limit of 1 to 10 in the document cart.
test_cases.priority_reason: Bulk copies bypass the per-order limit set by the University.
steps: Open the New document request page
test_cases.expected_result: The error 'Copies must be a whole number from 1 to 10.' is shown.

test_cases.title: Student cannot open the clerk's scrutiny workbench
test_cases.purpose: Checks that staff screens are closed to students, even by typing the address.
test_cases.priority_reason: Students could see other students' documents.
test_cases.expected_result: 'Access denied' is shown and 'Scrutiny workbench' is not shown.
acceptance_criteria: The clerk workbench is not displayed

test_cases.title: Student cannot lodge a grievance with a future incident date
test_cases.purpose: Checks the incident date cannot be after today.
test_cases.priority_reason: Future dates corrupt Service Level Agreement (SLA) reports.
steps: Enter '2099-01-01' in the Incident date field
Enter 'The library has been closed on weekdays for three weeks.' in the Describe your grievance field
test_cases.expected_result: The error 'The incident date cannot be in the future.' is shown.

test_cases.title: Student sees the grievance form labels in Kannada
test_cases.purpose: Checks every label switches when the student chooses Kannada.
test_cases.priority_reason: Some students read Kannada more easily; mixed labels confuse them.
test_cases.expected_result: The labels show 'ಘಟನೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ' and 'Incident date' is not shown.

test_cases.title: Staff member must still enter an OTP after ticking Remember this device
test_cases.purpose: Checks staff two-factor sign-in cannot be skipped.
test_cases.priority_reason: A stolen staff password alone would open the staff desks.
test_cases.expected_result: The page asks for the 'One-Time Password (OTP)'.

test_cases.title: Student's 5.3 MB identity file is rejected
test_cases.priority_reason: Large files slow scrutiny and storage.
steps: Open the New document request page
test_cases.expected_result: The message 'file is larger than 5 MB' is shown.
acceptance_criteria: The file is not listed as uploaded

test_cases.title: Visitor sees NOT VERIFIED for an unknown certificate code
test_cases.purpose: Checks the public verification page rejects codes that match nothing.
test_cases.priority_reason: Fake certificates could look genuine to employers.
steps: Enter 'abcdef0123456789' in the Verification code field
test_cases.expected_result: 'NOT VERIFIED' is shown and 'AUTHENTIC' is not shown.

test_cases.title: Student sees their dashboard after signing in
test_cases.purpose: Checks a student with correct details can sign in end to end.
test_cases.priority_reason: If sign-in fails, no student can use any service.

test_cases.title: Student cannot see an unrelated application when tracking with their own USN
test_cases.purpose: Checks tracking needs the application ID and its own USN together.
test_cases.priority_reason: Anyone could see another student's application status.
steps: Enter 'APP-2026-UNKNOWN' in the Application ID field
Enter '1KV21CS001' in the University Seat Number (USN) field

test_cases.title: Kannada wording on the grievance form reads naturally
test_cases.purpose: Checks translation quality, which needs a native speaker.
steps: Ask a native Kannada speaker to read the grievance form and note awkward phrases
test_cases.expected_result: The reviewer finds no awkward or wrong phrases.

coverage_notes: Example web suite for the KVTU practice portal: some pass, some catch planted bugs, one needs a human.
